text: Watter woord voltooi die sin: “Ek het hom gister nie gesien …”?
gloss: Which word completes: "I didn't see him yesterday ..."? — nie: Afrikaans double negation closes the sentence with a second «nie».

text: Wat is die verkleinwoord van ‘boom’?
gloss: What is the diminutive of "boom" (tree)? — Boompie: after -m the Afrikaans diminutive suffix is -pie.

text: Watter getal is ‘vier-en-dertig’?
gloss: Which number is "four-and-thirty"? — 34: Afrikaans says the units first; 43 is the trap.

text: ’n Suid-Afrikaanse ID-nommer begin met 850214. Op watter dag verjaar die persoon?
gloss: A South African ID number starts 850214. When is the birthday? — 14 February: the first six digits are YYMMDD (1985-02-14).

text: Jou afspraak is om halfdrie die middag. Hoe laat moet jy daar wees?
gloss: Your appointment is at "halfdrie" in the afternoon. What time? — 14:30: Afrikaans "half three" means half an hour before three (English speakers may think 15:30).

text: As jy voorafbetaalde elektrisiteit koop, in watter eenheid word die hoeveelheid wat jy kry, gemeet?
gloss: When you buy prepaid electricity, in what unit is the amount measured? — Kilowatt-hours (the units on the meter).

text: Watter soetgebak word gevleg, in olie gebraai en dan dadelik in koue stroop gedompel?
gloss: Which sweet is plaited, deep-fried and dunked straight into cold syrup? — Koeksister.

text: Watter boom word die ‘onderstebo-boom’ genoem, omdat sy kaal takke soos wortels lyk?
gloss: Which tree is called the "upside-down tree" because its bare branches look like roots? — The baobab (kremetart).

text: Watter stad se inwoners noem dit liefdevol ‘Jozi’ of ‘Egoli’?
gloss: Which city do its residents fondly call "Jozi" or "Egoli"? — Johannesburg (eGoli, "place of gold").

text: Watter liedjie van Master KG het in 2020 ’n wêreldwye dansuitdaging ontketen?
gloss: Which Master KG song set off a worldwide dance challenge in 2020? — Jerusalema (with Nomcebo Zikode).

text: Voltooi die spreekwoord: “Wie die kleine nie eer nie, is die grote nie … nie.”
gloss: Complete the proverb "Who does not honour the small is not ... of the great" — werd (worth).

text: Wat noem Suid-Afrikaners in die volksmond ’n verkeerslig?
gloss: What do South Africans colloquially call a traffic light? — A robot.

text: In die volksverhale oor Jakkals, watter dier is sy vaste maat wat altyd die kortste ent trek?
gloss: In the folk tales about Jackal, which animal is his regular companion who always loses out? — Wolf (the "Jakkals en Wolf" stories).

text: Wat beteken dit in krieket as die skeidsregter albei arms reguit bo sy kop lig?
gloss: In cricket, what does the umpire raising both arms straight above his head mean? — Six runs.

text: Op ’n Windows-rekenaar maak Ctrl saam met watter letter jou laaste stap ongedaan?
gloss: On a Windows computer, Ctrl plus which letter undoes your last step? — Z (X cuts, Y redoes).

text: Wat is die naam van Harry Potter se sneeuwit uil?
gloss: What is the name of Harry Potter's snow-white owl? — Hedwig. Errol is the Weasleys' old owl, Scabbers Ron's rat, Crookshanks Hermione's cat.

text: Watter stroomdiens se logo is ’n rooi ‘N’ teen ’n swart agtergrond?
gloss: Which streaming service's logo is a red "N" on black? — Netflix.

text: In watter van hierdie lande kan jy in die winter die noorderlig sien?
gloss: In which of these countries can you see the northern lights in winter? — Norway (Australia sees only the southern lights).

text: Wat is die normale liggaamstemperatuur van ’n gesonde mens, ongeveer?
gloss: What is the normal body temperature of a healthy person, roughly? — 37 °C.

text: Watter app se logo is ’n wit spokie op ’n geel agtergrond?
gloss: Which app's logo is a white ghost on yellow? — Snapchat.

text: Wat beteken twee blou regmerkies langs ’n WhatsApp-boodskap?
gloss: What do two blue ticks next to a WhatsApp message mean? — It has been read.

text: Watter kaas word in blokkies bo-op ’n tradisionele Griekse slaai gesit?
gloss: Which cheese is put in blocks on top of a traditional Greek salad? — Feta.

text: In watter boek word die seuntjie Mowgli deur wolwe grootgemaak?
gloss: In which book is the boy Mowgli raised by wolves? — The Jungle Book (Kipling); Tarzan is raised by apes.

text: In watter rekenaarspeletjie val blokke van bo af en verdwyn ’n ry sodra dit vol is?
gloss: In which computer game do blocks fall from above and a row vanishes once full? — Tetris.

text: Waarteen waarsku die UV-indeks in die weerberig?
gloss: What does the UV index in the weather report warn about? — Sunburn (strength of the sun's ultraviolet rays).

text: Wat beteken ‘ASAP’ in ’n werkboodskap?
gloss: What does "ASAP" mean in a work message? — As soon as possible.

text: Watter Sweedse groep het met ‘Dancing Queen’ en ‘Mamma Mia’ wêreldberoemd geword?
gloss: Which Swedish group became world-famous with "Dancing Queen" and "Mamma Mia"? — ABBA.

text: Watter land se webwerwe eindig op ‘.de’?
gloss: Which country's websites end in ".de"? — Germany (Deutschland); Denmark is .dk.

text: Watter speserye gee tradisionele biltong, saam met sout en asyn, sy kenmerkende smaak?
gloss: Which spice, with salt and vinegar, gives traditional biltong its typical taste? — Coriander.

text: Rooibos groei natuurlik net in een klein streek ter wêreld. In watter berge?
gloss: Rooibos grows wild in only one small region on earth. Which mountains? — The Cederberg.

text: Wat noem ’n gholfspeler dit as hy ’n putjie in een hou onder syfer voltooi?
gloss: What does a golfer call finishing a hole one stroke under par? — A birdie (voëltjie); eagle is two under.

text: ’n Glas is tot bo vol water met ys wat daarin dryf. Wat gebeur met die watervlak as die ys smelt?
gloss: A glass is full to the brim with water and floating ice. What happens to the level when the ice melts? — It stays the same: floating ice displaces exactly its own weight of water.

text: In die volksliedjie ‘Sarie Marais’ smeek die sanger om teruggebring te word na watter streek?
gloss: In the folk song "Sarie Marais" the singer begs to be taken back to which region? — The old Transvaal ("O bring my t'rug na die ou Transvaal").

text: Die rooi duine by Sossusvlei, van die hoogstes ter wêreld, lê in watter woestyn?
gloss: The red dunes at Sossusvlei, among the world's highest, lie in which desert? — The Namib.

text: Vir watter maatskappy het Jan van Riebeeck in 1652 ’n verversingspos aan die Kaap gestig?
gloss: For which company did Jan van Riebeeck set up a refreshment station at the Cape in 1652? — The Dutch East India Company (VOC).

text: Watter aktrise het in 2004 ’n Oscar gewen vir haar rol as reeksmoordenaar in ‘Monster’?
gloss: Which actress won a 2004 Oscar for playing a serial killer in "Monster"? — Charlize Theron, from Benoni.

text: Wie se ekspedisie het die eerste keer om die wêreld geseil, al het hy self op pad gesterf?
gloss: Whose expedition first sailed around the world, though he died on the way? — Ferdinand Magellan (killed in the Philippines in 1521).

text: Volgens die legende vaar die spookskip ‘Die Vlieënde Hollander’ vir ewig rond naby watter kaap?
gloss: By legend, the ghost ship "Flying Dutchman" sails forever off which cape? — The Cape of Good Hope.

text: Watter kunstenaar het in die sestigerjare blikkies Campbell-sop tot popkuns verhef?
gloss: Which artist turned Campbell's soup cans into pop art in the 1960s? — Andy Warhol.

text: Net een van hierdie diere is werklik familie van die vark. Watter een?
gloss: Only one of these is really related to the pig. Which? — The warthog (vlakvark); aardvark, porcupine and hippo only sound like pigs or cows in Afrikaans.

text: Dit staan 30–30 in ’n spel tennis en die opslaner wen die volgende punt. Wat is die telling nou?
gloss: It's 30–30 in a tennis game and the server wins the next point. What's the score? — 40–30 (advantage only follows deuce).

text: Watter draadlose tegnologie gebruik jou bankkaart as jy betaal deur dit net teen die masjien te tik?
gloss: Which wireless technology does your bank card use when you pay by tapping it on the machine? — NFC (near-field communication).

text: Watter Klein-Karoo-dorp se ‘veerpaleise’ is gebou toe volstruisvere ruim ’n eeu gelede soos goud was?
gloss: Which Little Karoo town's "feather palaces" were built when ostrich feathers were like gold over a century ago? — Oudtshoorn.

text: Watter land het, saam met die Vatikaan, ’n vierkantige vlag eerder as ’n reghoekige?
gloss: Which country, along with the Vatican, has a square rather than rectangular flag? — Switzerland.

text: ‘Stad’ word ‘stede’ in die meervoud. Watter woord kry ook ’n ander klinker in die meervoud?
gloss: "Stad" becomes "stede" in the plural. Which word also changes its vowel? — Skip (skepe); katte, beddens, honde keep theirs.

text: Watter kunstenaar het die beroemde landskappanele vir die Johannesburgse stasie geskilder?
gloss: Which artist painted the famous landscape panels for Johannesburg station? — J.H. Pierneef (the Station Panels, 1929–32).

text: Watter fantasieskrywer is in 1892 in Bloemfontein gebore?
gloss: Which fantasy writer was born in Bloemfontein in 1892? — J.R.R. Tolkien.

text: Watter element is in 1868 in die Son se lig ontdek, jare voordat iemand dit op Aarde gevind het?
gloss: Which element was discovered in the Sun's light in 1868, years before anyone found it on Earth? — Helium (isolated on Earth in 1895).

text: Eugène Marais se ‘Die siel van die mier’ gaan eintlik oor watter insekte?
gloss: Eugène Marais's "The Soul of the White Ant" is actually about which insects? — Termites.

text: Watter Suid-Afrikaner het in 1979 ’n Nobelprys gedeel vir die wiskunde agter die CT-skandeerder?
gloss: Which South African shared a 1979 Nobel Prize for the mathematics behind the CT scanner? — Allan Cormack, with Godfrey Hounsfield; the others are South African-born laureates too.
